CITY OF LA VERNE
  SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  AGENDA

Terry Kistler, Chair  La Verne Community Center
Bette Donovan, Member  Classroom 1
Edward Padgett, Member  3680 D Street
Scott Snider, Member  La Verne, CA 91750
Jenny Jolly, Member  (909) 596-8776
George Borst, Member
Valarie Ortiz, Member
Yvonne Duran, Staff Liaison
Armando Cisneros, Staff Liaison
Robyn Olsen, Staff Liaison

  Wednesday, January 21, 2026 – 10:00 a.m.
  La Verne Community Center Classroom 1

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
La Verne Community Center at (909) 596-8776 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Public comments will be allowed near the conclusion of the meeting.

  1. ROLL CALL – Terry Kistler, Bette Donovan, Edward Padgett, Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly,
  George Borst, Valarie Ortiz

  2. PRESENTATIONS – Daniel Gonzalez, Rail Safety & Mobility Programs, LA Metro

  3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES – November 19, 2025.

  4. DISCUSSION & ACTION ITEMS
  a. Senior Nutrition Program
  b. Meals on Wheels Program
  c. Bingo Report
  d. Account Balance Update
  e. Monthly Senior Program Fees
  f. Mt. SAC Classes Update
  g. Aging Next
  h. Outstanding Older American
  i. Facilities Report
   j. Upcoming Events
  k. State of the City

  5. PUBLIC COMMENT
  Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject
  matter jurisdiction of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda
  items except as provided by law.

  6. STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION/INFORMATION

  7. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 a.m. on February 18, 2026 at the La Verne Community Center, 3680 D Street,
  La Verne CA 91750.

Posting Statement: On January 14, 2026 a true and correct copy of this Notice was posted on
the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at
www.laverneca.gov.
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, January 21, 2026

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, January 21, 2026.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, George Borst,
  Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly.

  Members Absent: Valarie Ortiz.

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Parks & Recreation Specialist, Yvonne
  Duran, Parks & Recreation Director.

  It was moved by Edward Padgett and seconded by Terry Kistler to approve the
  minutes of Wednesday, November 19, 2025 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Daniel Gonzalez, Rail Safety & Mobility Programs, La Metro. He
  talked about the Move Rider’s Program. He also explained that a local travel club
  with the volunteer travel buddy is available for seniors. Also discussed the
  places Tap Card Agencies are located to obtain a card. There are reduced fares
  for the senior tap card. For more information, go to Metro.net/onthemove and
  taptogo.net.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 572 meals were served to an average of 27 participants in
  December.

  Meals on Wheels: N/A.

4. Bingo Report: Bingo is doing well. The average number of members per
  month was 65 - 70 participants.

5. Account Balance: $6,015.94.

6. Senior Program Fees: All program fees are paid.
 7. MT. SAC Classes: The winter session is going well.

8. Outstanding Older American: Applications were reviewed and the final votes took
  place. The recipient of this year’s Outstanding Older American Award is Jack
  Mansell.

9. Aging Next: Total Number of La Verne Residents served for the month of
  November was 15. La Verne Residents served via Joslyn Center: N/A.
  La Verne Residents served via AgingNext Office N/A.

  New Business

10. Facilities Report: Yvonne reported that the leak in the senior craft room will be
  repaired. The kitchen in the Community Center may need a new ice machine.
  Veterans Hall is in good condition.

11. Upcoming Events

  •  Friday, January 23 – Excursion: Rancho Los Alamitos & Seal Beach, 8:30AM – 4:00PM.
  •  Friday, January 23 – Senior Seminar: Aging and Vision Loss, Independence at Home, 10:30AM.
  •  Friday, February 6 – Excursion: Fossils & Fuel with Curt Tucker, 8:30AM – 5:00PM.
  •  Monday, February 9 –Movie Matinee: La La Land, 12:30PM.
  •  Wednesday, February 11 – Senior Seminar: Living Better with Arthritis, Independence at Home,
  10:30AM.
  •  Friday, February 13 – Sweetheart’s Dance for those with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities,
  5:00PM-8:00PM.

  Public Comments: The State of the City of La Verne will take place at ULV on
  Wednesday, February 18. Members discussed possible attendance, which may
  affect the meeting.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 11:15AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, February 18, 2026 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Parks & Recreation Specialist
